Each mutex lock has a Boolean variable ⟦MC_06d65c3dfe60fb0e_0⟧ that indicates whether the lock is available.
If the lock is available, calling ⟦MC_ae22a4ea5acb3f84_1⟧ succeeds, and the lock is no longer available.
When a process attempts to acquire an unavailable lock, it is blocked until the lock is released.
